steps.title: Configure App Metadata
steps.description: Establish and verify app-meta.json configuration values for AC Resizer with the package name com.acresizer.app.

steps.title: Verify settings.gradle
steps.description: Confirm root module inclusion configurations align with Gradle 8.5.

steps.title: Establish Top-Level build.gradle
steps.description: Verify Google and Maven Central repositories with AGP 8.3.2 configurations.

steps.title: Configure App Module build.gradle
steps.description: Ensure compilation configs target SDK 34, set the namespace and applicationId to com.acresizer.app, and declare Java 1.8 compatibility.

steps.title: Verify Android Manifest Integration
steps.description: Validate AndroidManifest.xml package paths, application label for AC Resizer, launchers, and permissions inside valid Android namespace configurations.

steps.title: Create Card Background Drawable
steps.description: Generate card_bg.xml drawable with custom radius corners, background solid color, and border stroke.

steps.title: Create Primary Button Background Drawable
steps.description: Generate button_bg.xml drawable with primary classic blue branding and corner radius shape attributes.

steps.title: Create Secondary Button Background Drawable
steps.description: Generate button_secondary_bg.xml with accent green coloration styling.

steps.title: Create Text Input Background Drawable
steps.description: Generate input_bg.xml with border outline stroke and rounded bounds for edit text fields.

steps.title: Create Preset Button Background Drawable
steps.description: Generate preset_button_bg.xml drawable for selection tiles with soft blue hues.

steps.title: Verify activity_main.xml integration
steps.description: Ensure all layout reference assets link correctly to layout components and views.

steps.title: Update Package and Class Imports in MainActivity.java
steps.description: Refactor package declarations and title strings inside MainActivity.java to refer correctly to com.acresizer.app.

steps.title: Building AC Resizer
steps.description: Execute gradle assembleDebug to build the final stable, upgraded AC Resizer APK.
